rounds.text: Sunlite Recycling Industries Ltd is trading at a compelling valuation with a P/E of 15.8x [E1], which is a steep discount to the sector benchmark P/E of 27.45x [E6]. This low valuation disconnects sharply from the company's hyper-growth profile, highlighted by a trailing twelve-month sales growth of 98% [E13] and an explosive net profit growth of 183% [E12, E15]. Furthermore, the business generates exceptional returns on capital, boasting an ROCE of 32.58% against a sector benchmark of 18.2% [E9], alongside a 3-year median ROE of 39% [E17]. Financial risk is minimal given that the company is almost debt-free with a debt-to-equity ratio of just 0.07x [E27, E40], while high insider commitment is evident as promoters increased their holding to 74.47% [E30]. A discounted cash flow model suggests a massive intrinsic value buffer with a margin of safety of 61.2% [E34, E35], and the reverse DCF indicates that the current share price only prices in a meager 5.0% earnings growth [E36]. Conceded: operating cash flow turned negative at minus Rs 2 Cr in Mar 2026, leading to a weak cash conversion of minus 0.05x [E23, E24].
